tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the issuing Ansvra account and eligible projects for this connection. Show the options when the user asks to pick a project and pass the selected ID to other tools. Use the returned nextCursor to continue with the same limit.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Identify the selected Ansvra project, including its name, website, market, and language. An All account projects key requires a project ID.

tools.name: list_tracked_prompts
tools.description: Find tracked prompts and their IDs. Pass the returned nextCursor to continue with the same filters.

tools.name: get_prompt_results
tools.description: Read saved results for a tracked prompt. Use list_tracked_prompts to find the prompt ID. Use the responses view to find an observation ID, then pass that ID to read the full answer.

tools.name: get_visibility_overview
tools.description: Summarize AI visibility, mentions and citations for the selected period, with comparison where available.

tools.name: get_visibility_trend
tools.description: Show AI visibility and citation measures over time.

tools.name: get_competitor_comparison
tools.description: Compare brand visibility, citations and answer coverage with configured competitors.

tools.name: get_brand_sentiment
tools.description: Read saved brand sentiment, trends and classification coverage.

tools.name: get_shopping_visibility
tools.description: Read saved shopping visibility and product appearances in AI answers.

tools.name: get_growth_actions
tools.description: Read saved Growth recommendations and their supporting evidence.

tools.name: get_citations
tools.description: Find pages or domains cited in saved answers. Use page to browse the results.

tools.name: get_website_report
tools.description: Read saved website traffic or Google search performance. Use the report's coverage and saved date to interpret its availability.

tools.name: get_crawler_activity
tools.description: Summarize recorded crawler requests or show the most active crawlers and pages. Use page to browse additional rows.
